description: PAID tool ($0.01 USDC via x402, Base). Resolve up to 100 artifact freshness records in one call against live registries and cryptographically verified CANON publisher manifests: detects stale mirrors, superseded artifacts, and publisher/registry conflicts. Send the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header on the /mcp request; without payment the call returns the canonical x402 challenge (HTTP 402, amount 10000 = $0.01 USDC, payTo of the CANON endpoint). Settlement is performed by the canonical CANON endpoint on SqueezeOS; this MCP never holds funds and never pays on your behalf.

items.description: One to 100 package or artifact freshness checks.

held_integrity.description: Optional integrity value currently held by the caller, for tamper comparison when evidence supports it.

held_version.description: Optional version currently held by the caller or mirror, for freshness comparison.

id.description: Package or artifact identifier to resolve, e.g. an npm package name.

publisher_domain.description: Optional public publisher domain whose CANON manifest and Ed25519 keyset should be verified.

type.description: Artifact family; omit only when CANON can infer it from the identifier.

name: canon_registry_bulk_lookup
title: CANON Registry Bulk Lookup
